title: Every chart on the shipped surface names one of the six committed forms and honours the render-shell contract
asA: product owner responsible for the shipped surface's data affordances
iWant: every chart the surface renders to pick one of the six committed forms and route through the render-shell contract
soThat: the accessibility, palette and text-alternative discipline the shell owns applies to every chart on the surface without a per-chart negotiation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart on the surface, the chart's declared form matches one of {bar, line, area, pie, donut, single-value, sparkline, heatmap}; a form outside this set is refused at project-side review or documented on the blueprint's README as a project-authored deviation.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered chart on the shipped surface
acceptanceCriteria.when: the surface is reviewed against the shelf
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chart's declared form is one of the six committed forms or a documented project deviation

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart, the chart mounts through the render-shell contract (TAC-1901): the shell exposes the accessible-defaults palette hook (ADR-1902) and the text-alternative slot; a chart that skips the shell contract (renders through a raw chart-library mount) is refused at project-side review.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chart is mounted through TAC-1901's render shell

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart, when the chart's declared form matches one of the six committed forms (bar, line, area, pie, donut, single-value, sparkline, heatmap), the shell exposes a per-form binder resolving the values to the form's DOM primitives (rects for bar, path for line and area, arcs for pie or donut, one text node for single-value, mini-path for sparkline, grid cells for heatmap); a form whose binder is absent fails the pack check.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered chart of one of the six committed forms
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the shell's form binder
acceptanceCriteria.then: the shell exposes the per-form binder resolving values to the form's DOM primitives; a missing binder fails the check

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a specialised form the applying project needs (a candlestick, a Sankey), the project's README carries a CALLS MADE entry naming the deviation and the project supersedes REQ-001 with a project-authored REQ that names the deviating form; a specialised form without a documented CALLS MADE + superseding REQ fails project-side review. Applying agent sets: the specialised chart form the project needs (a candlestick, a Sankey), the CALLS MADE entry text (the deviation from the six-form set quoted verbatim and the project's reason), and the project-authored superseding REQ id that names the deviating form.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an applying project shipping a form outside the six committed
acceptanceCriteria.when: review inspects the project's CALLS MADE and REQ set
acceptanceCriteria.then: the deviation is documented with a project-authored superseding REQ; an undocumented deviation fails review

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a rendered chart whose form is declared correctly but whose data set is empty (no series values), the shell renders a labelled empty-state block (`role="region"` with an accessible name naming the empty condition) inside the same landmark as the chart; a shell that renders a blank chart canvas with no announcement fails the pack check.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a rendered chart with an empty data set
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pack inspects the shell's render
acceptanceCriteria.then: the shell renders a labelled empty-state block with an accessible name inside the chart's landmark; a silent blank chart fails
